title: 视频剪辑 current runtime connection snapshot
description: A non-secret connection hint copied from actual owner responses. This file is not authorization, a service launcher or an alternative owner ledger. CLI verifies all current service facts before each attachment.

dataDir.description: Absolute actual installed application data root; owner-injected data directory wins during launch.

port.description: Actual existing loopback service port returned by its owner.

instanceId.description: Exact instanceId from current /api/desirecore/instance; never product or Agent UUID.

scopeId.description: Exact scopeId from current platform runtime binding.

runtimeGeneration.description: Exact generation from current platform runtime binding; stale generations are rejected.

releaseDigest.description: Exact app-release-c14n-v1 SHA256 of the current installed runtime binding; not source/archive SHA.
